steps.js: const g=__dmh;__sim(20);const names=[...new Set(g.data.enemies.map(e=>e.art).concat(g.data.bosses.map(b=>b.art)))];const out=[];let total=0;for(const n of names){const A=g.b3audit(n);if(!A||!A.length){out.push(n+':NOPARTS');continue;}const tris=A.reduce((s,p)=>s+(p.tris||0),0);total+=tris;const issues=[];for(const p of A){if(p.missing)issues.push(p.role+' missing');else{if(p.tris<4)issues.push(p.role+' tris='+p.tris);if(p.bad)issues.push(p.role+' NaN');if(p.thick<1.2&&!/Wing|Prop/.test(p.role))issues.push(p.role+' thin='+p.thick+' ('+p.w+'x'+p.h+')');if(p.thick>Math.min(p.w,p.h)*0.55)issues.push(p.role+' fat='+p.thick);}}if(issues.length)out.push(n+': '+issues.join(', '));if(tris>4500)out.push(n+': heavy '+tris);}JSON.stringify({kinds:names.length,avgTris:Math.round(total/names.length),issues:out})
